result.text:
# DP-GEN and model deviation

DP-GEN is a concurrent-learning platform for generating reliable deep-learning
potential-energy models for atomistic simulation. Its workflow alternates
exploration, labeling, and retraining, and the generated model-deviation input
is part of the exploration step used to decide which structures should be sent
for labeling.

The relevant scientific contract for this task is simple: a valid settings
record should lead to consistent generated input in the workflow.

Relevant public references:

- [DP-GEN documentation](https://docs.deepmodeling.com/projects/dpgen/en/latest/)
- [DP-GEN paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cpc.2020.107206)
- [DeePMD-kit documentation on relative model deviation](https://docs.deepmodeling.com/projects/deepmd/en/latest/)
No images are required for this task.

The template-revision path in `source/dpgen/generator/run.py` was inconsistent with the reference `make_lammps_input` in `source/dpgen/generator/lib/lammps.py`:

- `build_template_options` dropped `workflow_options` (and `ele_temp_f`/`ele_temp_a`) from the settings, so the template renderer never saw them.
- `revise_lmp_input_model` only branched on `use_ele_temp` (0/1) and never emitted the `atomic`/`relative`/`relative_v`/`aparam` model-control terms — so the rendered `pair_style` line omitted them (the observed `missing_pair_tokens`).
- The dump revision wasn't wired into `render_external_template_input`, and `revise_lmp_input_dump` didn't emit the `dump_modify` restart-append directive that `merge_traj` requires.

**Fix** (all in `source/dpgen/generator/run.py`, settings-driven — nothing hard-coded):

- `build_template_options` now propagates `workflow_options` and derives `ele_temp_f`/`ele_temp_a` (and `use_ele_temp` 1/2) from the settings.
- `revise_lmp_input_model` builds the keyword tail exactly like the reference (`atomic`, `relative {epsilon}`, `relative_v {epsilon_v}`, `fparam`/`aparam`), and also fixes the previously-unhandled `use_ele_temp == 2` (aparam) case.
- `revise_lmp_input_dump` now switches the trajectory path to `all.lammpstrj` and adds the `dump_modify ... append yes` directive when `model_devi_merge_traj` is set (no-op otherwise, so the public fixture's `traj/*.lammpstrj` dump is untouched).
- `render_external_template_input` calls both revisions so the rendered input stays consistent with the settings.

**Verification**

- Public fixture: `status: workflow_completed`, all required pair tokens present, dump consistent.
- Combinations checked (clusters/relative/relative_v on/off, `ele_temp_f`→`fparam`, `ele_temp_a`→`aparam`, `merge_traj=true` with `all.lammpstrj`+`dump_modify`, varied graph lists/`trj_freq`) all pass via the reproduction's own observation logic.

One note: `deepmd_version < "1"` keeps the legacy `pair_style` form (no keyword tail), matching `make_lammps_input` — the relative/clusters options are a deepmd ≥ 1 feature, so that's not a valid combination for those terms.
